engine.notes: PIG is the only theater; the rest of Rhode Island improv is weekly or monthly shows in borrowed rooms. The Comedy Connection in East Providence is stand-up, AS220's Empire Revue is sketch, and the Wilbury Theatre Group is a scripted company whose site could not be read.

entries.name: Providence Improv Guild
entries.summary: Providence's nonprofit improv theater on Empire Street, with shows every Friday and Saturday headlined by a nightly house team, open-jam and new-team slots on the bill, and levelled classes from Intro to Improv upward.
entries.schedule: Fridays 7:30 pm, Saturdays 7:30 and 9:30 pm, $10; classes $225, Level 1 and Level 3 sold out
signals: Open jam and new-team workout slots
entries.reasons: A permanent downtown theater, three weekly shows with house teams and jam slots, and sold-out levelled classes; the founding year and the full class ladder are not stated on the site.

entries.name: Bring Your Own Improv
entries.summary: Interactive improv company running two shows every Friday at the Warwick Center for the Arts since 2008, a family-friendly early show and the late Caffeinated Insomniacs, plus teen workshops.
entries.schedule: Every Friday 8 pm (family) and 10 pm (late), $15, $10 concessions
signals: Warwick Center for the Arts, 3259 Post Rd
entries.reasons: Eighteen years of weekly shows in a fixed venue earn the longevity points; classes are teen workshops only and the site gives no dates for them.

entries.name: Improv Jones
entries.summary: A troupe that began as a workshop at Second Story Theatre in 1992 and now plays a monthly Improv Jones & Friends show at Borealis Coffee Company in Bristol, on the East Bay.
entries.schedule: Monthly; next show Oct 3, 2026 at 7:30 pm
signals: Monthly show at Borealis Coffee, 500 Wood St, Bristol
Classes via Kate Teichman, none scheduled now
entries.reasons: A three-decade lineage and a dated next show, but one night a month in a coffee shop and no classes running.
